content: लङ्घनम् [लङ्घ्-ल्युट्] .²1 Leaping, jumping. .²2 Going by leaps, traversing, passing over, going, motion in general; यूयमेव पथि शीघ्रलङ्घनाः <ls>Ghaṭ. 8</ls>. .²3 Mounting, ascending, rising up to (<ab>fig.</ab> also); नभोलङ्घन <ls>R. 16. 33</ls>; जनोऽयमुच्चैःपदलङ्घनोत्सुकः <ls>Ku. 5. 64</ls> ‘wishing to attain or aspire to a high position’. .²4 Assaulting, storming, capturing; as in दुर्गलङ्घनम्. .²5 Exceeding, going beyond, overstepping, violating, transgression; आज्ञालङ्घनम्, नियमलङ्घनम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 Disregarding, despising, treating with contempt, slighting; प्रणिपातलङ्घनं प्रमार्ष्टुकामा <ls>V. 3</ls>; <ls>M. 3. 22</ls>. .²7 An offence, affront, insult. .²8 A harm, an injury; as in आतपलङ्घनम् <ab>q. v.</ab> .²9 Fasting, abstinence; प्रचक्रमे लङ्घनपूर्वकं क्रमः <ls>Śi. 12. 25</ls> (where it menans ‘leaping’ also). .²10 One of the paces of a horse. .²11 Sexual union, impregnating.
